_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. epidemicsound.com declares its design-token layer in its stylesheets (raw/css-vars.json): theme-invariant scales under core.* and the semantic --es-color-* layer emitted under both light.* and dark.* so each theme resolves its own value. Measured roles alias to the declared values where they match.

ui.description: The declared Inter stack — every UI control, body and meta text (aliases --es-i-text-font-family, --pds-font-primary).

display.description: The declared Sebenta stack — every es-heading/es-subheading and the h1-h6 layer (alias --es-i-header-font-family).

regular.description: 400 — the es-text-xs meta weight; body text sits at 500.

medium.description: 500 — every es-heading, es-subheading-l, es-text-l/xl/m/s and buttons' base weight.
